name: medqa_s38_v1_r1_strict_early
responses: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. My main symptom is Bilious vomiting. I also have Feeding intolerance, No fever, Vomiting started within first day after birth. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.
Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Brother had pyloric stenosis. Social history: NA
